notes.title: Gladiators and Glory Released to Full Version
notes.content:
Features added since Early access:
Added Easy, Normal and Hard Difficulty modes
Added Battle Speed Options
2 vs 2 Gladiator Fighting Arena Added
Added 10 arena to 2 vs 2 Gladiator arena.
In 1 vs 1 Gladiator arena, the number of arenas increased from 5 to 10
The number of Gladiator Champions has been increased to 10.
The total number of Gladiators that can be owned has been increased from 3 to 6.
Total number of Gladiators available for purchase increased from 15 to 30.
The number of Gladiator classes increased from 6 to 15.
Gladiator comparison screen has been added to all arenas.
In the Training section in Ludus, the shift key has been added to increase 10 traits.
Cancel option has been added to exit the Find a Fight screen and the Skip to next week screen.
Many bugs in the game have been fixed.
In-game balance has been improved

I would appreciate your support by writing a review.

notes.title: Armoured Gladiators Added to Gladiator Market
notes.content: [h3][b]Armoured Gladiators Added to Gladiator Market. 3 Experienced Armoured Gladiators, 3 Armoured Gladiators, 3 Experienced Northern Warriors Added. A Few Bugs Fixed.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: 2 vs 2 Arena, Difficulty Levels 9th and 10th Arenas in 1 vs 1 Arena, Arrived
notes.content:
With this major update, many improvements have been made to the game:
2 vs 2 Arena opened. With this Arena, which you will enter when you can have 2 gladiators, you will be able to earn both Glory and Money and you will be able to lower the Glory of rival Ludus.
The 9th and 10th Arenas of the 1 vs 1 Arena have been opened. The Champion of the 10th Arena is a really strong Champion.
Two Difficulty levels have been added to the game as Easy and Normal. With the addition of difficulty levels, the balance of the game has been reviewed and improved.
While fixing many minor bugs in the game, some improvements have been made. For example, yellow colour has been added for you to find yourself more easily in the Ludus ranking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161202/8bc5db2c66787c2638e7ef3ae535d1b41eba8794.png[/img]

notes.title: Gladiators and Glory Update
notes.content: In this update: shift + Left click button to spend 10 Energy and increase your 10 Stats has been added to the game. In the pre-fight Selection Screen, Comparison Texts have been added so that you can better compare the opponents you will fight with your Gladiators. After an opponent is selected, it has been made easier to change your mind and choose another opponent. The balance of the game has been adjusted throughout the game. Fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Two New Arenas Added to Gladiators and Glory with Update
notes.content:
[h3]What's coming to Gladiators and Glory in the update:
7th and 8th Arena unlocked
In your ludus, all stats have been informed.
The Cancel option has been added, allowing you to exit the Find a Opponent screen and the Skip to next week screen.
Many small bugs have been fixed.[/h3]

notes.title: Gladiators and Glory is released to Early Access
notes.content:
My game Gladiators and Glory Early Access has been released. If you wish, you can have my game with a 20% discount valid for 1 week.

If you like my game, I would be very happy if you write a review and express your opinions. Thank you for everything.

notes.title: Gladiators and Glory Demo has been Released
notes.content: The demo of my game is released. I continue to develop my game. There are some restrictions in the demo. The most important of these, the total number of Gladiators from 6 to 3 has been reduced. The total number of 30 gladiators has been reduced to 9. The number of Arena, which is 10 for now, has been reduced to 4. If you like the demo, I would be very happy if you take it to the Wish list.
